name: Ab Wheel Standing Rollout
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hinge at your hips to grip the ab wheel handles on the floor.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly with straight arms before starting the movement.
Roll the wheel smoothly forward along the floor until your torso and legs extend near a straight horizontal line.
Press firmly down into the handles and engage your abs and lats to draw the wheel back toward your feet.
tips: Shorten the rollout distance if your lower back starts to sag or your pelvis loses control.
Keep your elbows straight and shoulders strong rather than collapsing toward the floor at full extension.
